description: This PHP class 'FileManager' is part of the OpenCart admin controller, managing file operations such as listing, uploading, creating folders, and deleting files within the admin panel. It interacts with the filesystem and renders views for file management.

classes.name: FileManager
classes.description: Controller class handling file management operations in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the file manager view with configurations, parameters, and list data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of files and directories.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the file list, including files and directories with pagination and filtering.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles file uploads, validating and saving uploaded files.

methods.name: folder
methods.description: Creates a new directory within the file system after validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified files or directories after permission and path validation.
